title: A Day on Venus Is Longer Than Its Year
description:
On Venus, one day lasts longer than a whole year. Here's how that works, and why the Sun rises in the west there.

Follow MarketOpsTips for a surprising fact every evening.

#facts #space #shorts

beats.say: On Venus, a year ends before a single day does.
Venus takes 225 Earth days to go around the Sun.
But it spins so slowly that one full turn takes 243 Earth days.
And it spins backwards, so the Sun rises in the west.
If you lived there, you'd have a birthday before you ever saw tomorrow.
